"# Implementation Plan - Restoring Franchise Page Slides 11-14

Restore Slides 11–14 on the Franchise page ([FranchisePageClient.tsx](file:///d:/anti-gv/25. 120pie(new)_2/app/franchise/FranchisePageClient.tsx)) to their fully redesigned versions.

## Proposed Changes

### Franchise Page Client Component

#### [MODIFY] [FranchisePageClient.tsx](file:///d:/anti-gv/25. 120pie(new)_2/app/franchise/FranchisePageClient.tsx)

We will modify Sections 11, 12, 13, and 14 in `FranchisePageClient.tsx`:
